title: Akcent KitPvP
description: A KitPvP server aimed at creating a unique pvp feel. Made using a custom-made Data Pack allowing the server to be constantly up-to-date with the newest game Updates
body:
A KitPvP server aimed at creating a unique PvP feel. Made using a custom Data Pack allowing the server to be constantly up-to-date with the newest game Updates.

The Server is inspired by Classic KitPvP experiences from the golden Age of Minecraft Servers. 
Currently there are 18 Implemented Kits ranging across Three Tiers, with more Kits planned for the Future. Additionally, there are 18 Perks, with effects ranging from additional Attack Damage to higher Kill Rewards, allowing for various play-styles suiting most players.
